rationale: direction_sign is the spine's sign: 1 favourable, -1 unfavourable for risk appetite or the named entity (references/typing_prompt_v1.txt rule 8). Textbook oil-supply channel. More supply is favourable for risk (+1): it lowers oil prices (event -> oil_supply +; oil_supply -> USO -, oil_supply -> XLE -) and, as input-cost relief, lifts risk_appetite (+) and so SPY (+). Documentation, not data.
